[Unit]
Description=Private tunnel from China control plane to China Kokoro GPU
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ssh -NT -i /etc/castreader/cn-clone-tunnel -o BatchMode=yes -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=20 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/etc/castreader/cn4090-known-hosts -p 12085 -L 127.0.0.1:18880:127.0.0.1:8880 root@connect.bjb1.seetacloud.com
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=strict

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
